name: Fujimori Kotomi
source:
A simple schoolgirl in [url=/c28421]Ebina Yasushi[/url]'s class.

She used to date [url=/c28422]Nakayama Shunsuke[/url], but as soon as he went off to college, they drifted apart and their relationship naturally dissolved. 

One day, she learned that Shunsuke had a new girlfriend, and was shocked to find out that she was the complete opposite of herself.

She joined the group to regain her self-confidence.
